A calm, completely private space, without any judgment on your feelings. All yours alone.
Your privacy is not a detail, it is a foundation
Without your real name, without a phone number. Every word you write is encrypted on your device only — even our team cannot access it.
With you even if the internet is cut off
Salam works without internet at all, and your companion is ready to hear you at any time — in a calm style based on simple scientific methods (CBT).
A companion by your side, not a replacement for you

Salam supports you, but it is not a substitute for a specialist. If we feel you need more help, we will immediately direct you to resources that can support you. And this is something we are proud of, not hidden 💙
Always with you in the hardest moments
A psychological survival box, calm environments, and exercises ready with one click when needed.
A friendly place that helps you understand your feelings and find simple things that help you feel calm.
